content.rationale: S3-revert (`kttmwrsv`) fixes the write half — the selective revert of a named operation's entries, whole operations only, no partial, file-level or snapshot revert; M-layout (`szmuyqrq`) places the module flat at `src/revert.rs`. It names the entries and crosses `jj op revert <id>` over each through the runner (M-jj, `zruxtxrv`) — merge-based, so concurrent work inside the window survives — returning each crossing's outcome; which operation's entries those are, and in what order, is the undo/redo layer's concern.
